messages:
maria: Heads-up — small-batch latency spike on canary (commit abc123) when paged-KV + FlashAttention 2.1 are both enabled. Spike shows up as ~3–8ms tail for 1-4 token batches, seems like queue skew + a spinlock hot path. :eyes:
ken: interesting, is this on Dedicated or hosted canary? any perf traces?
maria: hosted canary in us-west, load shape = bursty PLG traffic. attaching quick perf snippet from async profiler:
```
PID 4321  cpu 98%  flame: spin_lock_paged_kv_prefetch (hot)
  -> prepare_kv_page_prefetch
  -> kernel_selector::choose(FlashAttention)
  -> batch_queue::coalesce_small_batches
  -> runtime::dispatch_kernel
```
ashok: that spin lock in prefetch looks like it serializes small batches trying to touch paged pages. When batcher coalesces 1-token requests it triggers prefetch for each request concurrently -> contention.
lina: we tuned token_budget down to force larger batches historically, what are current token_budget and max_wait_ms?
maria: token_budget = 24, max_wait_ms = 8. But traffic has many 1-token requests; coalescer forms many tiny batches and then kernel selector flips to FlashAttention path which calls paged-kv prefetch.
tim: two levers: 1) avoid prefetch for tiny batches (threshold), 2) change queue policy to prefer latency SLOs and delay tiny tokens slightly to get 2-3 token batches. I'd try 1st first.
ashok: agree. quick patch: short-circuit paged-kv prefetch when batch.tokens <= 2. Profiling shows prefetch benefit is negative under 4 tokens.
ken: can we also measure spinlock wait time per request? add tracing for lock_acquire_ns field. helps validate.
maria: created a canary config for experiment: 
```yaml
batcher:
  prefer_latency: true
  min_prefetch_tokens: 3   # don't prefetch if total batch tokens < 3
  coalesce_window_ms: 6
  sampling_window: 1000
```
I'll roll this to canary-3 and run 30m test.
ken: i'll add extra metrics: `kv_prefetch_skews`, `lock_acquire_ns_p50/p95/p99`, and `batch_size_histogram` to the dashboard. link: https://internal.perf/redwood/canary-3
maria: rolled canary-3 -> deploy-bot: 
deploy-bot: canary-3 deployed to us-west (id canary-3, commit abc123, rollout 10%).
ashok: quick thought: if we short-circuit prefetch we should still record a counter to detect regression for long sequences where prefetch helps. toggle = safe.
lina: also consider changing kernel selector priority: prefer non-prefetch FlashAttention path if batch.tokens < 8, even if paged-kv available. reduces hop to prefetch code.
tim: if experiment improves tail by >2ms for small batches, we'll promote. If not, revert and try small delay heuristic (delay up to 10ms to accumulate).
maria: running now. initial 5m looks promising: p99 latency for 1-3 tokens down ~3.4ms, lock_acquire_p99 down 70%. Will report full 30m. :thumbsup:
ken: thanks, please paste the final numbers here and we'll update the batcher tune doc.
maria: will do. action items: (1) ashok implement prefetch short-circuit + counter, (2) ken add metrics & dashboard, (3) lina add kernel selection tweak draft, (4) tim validate SLO impact.
ken: ack.
ashok: working on patch, pushing branch `hotfix/prefetch-guard`
maria: great — if spike returns we can also test increasing `coalesce_window_ms` to 12ms as fallback.
ken: noted. :thinking_face:
